image_description: A rustic outdoor scene featuring two wooden rain barrels positioned against a weathered wooden building wall. The barrel on the right is prominent, showing wood staves and metal bands, with a white downspout pipe feeding into its top opening. A garden hose connects to a spigot near the base of this barrel. To the left, a second similar barrel is partially visible. The ground is covered in dirt and scattered leaves.
